`duty.py` gets the tariff schedule's location from a `DUTYBOOK` environment variable. The README doesn't mention it, and it wasn't set. `schedules/hs-2026.csv` is the only schedule in the repo, so I ran it like this, with `duty.py` unchanged:

```
DUTYBOOK=schedules/hs-2026.csv python3 duty.py manifests/ship-0412.csv
```

I also saved a note in memcue that the script needs `DUTYBOOK`, so a later session won't have to work it out again.
